tasks.short: Gather trends from shows, magazines and manuals

steps.what: Attend fashion shows to gather information about trends
Review garment magazines and manuals for consumer preferences
Quote each marked page into one trend line

loop.input: A magazine or manual page she marked in s2
loop.output: One trend line that quotes that page
loop.check: The quote is a span on that page. A line with no quote is unmarked and dropped.
loop.stop: One line per marked page, or stop when a page yields no quote. She still chooses in s4.
loop.why_not_simpler: A keyword or a date cannot tell a fashion trend from an advertisement.

steps.what: Choose which gathered preferences the line will follow

tasks.design: She still attends the show and reads the magazine or manual. A note in {DOCS} quotes only a page she marked, and she chooses which consumer preference the line follows. The show and that choice stay hers.
tasks.previous_blocker: The useful part is what she sees in the room and on the page. A keyword list cannot tell a preference from an advertisement.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded note can quote a page she already marked and drop a line that has no quote.
tasks.still_hard: Which preference will sell, and what she saw on a person in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the line takes from the show and from the page.
tasks.altitude: Her week still includes the shows and the reading. She gains no new decision right. The note does not choose the line.

reach.task: Record a consumer constraint on a product
reach.learn: Write a preference as who it is for and what must change, not as a mood word.

evidence.claim: A note can be limited to a quote from a page the designer marked. A keyword or a date cannot tell a trend from an advertisement.
Text-to-image adopters' average novelty fell after the first month, so a generated line is not a reason to skip her choice of what the line follows.

assumptions: This task stops at her preference choice. A campaign, a sketch and a buy are other tasks.
The quote note needs page_id and a quote. She produces both by marking the page in s2. If she leaves no mark, the note does not run and she writes the choice from the show notes.
Today she copies the line. The machine is only the future of that copying. She remains the person who reads and who chooses.
No second trend list is kept, so ongoing upkeep beyond the steps is zero.
Print pages that are not stored as text do not feed the note.
unknowns: Whether the company may store the magazine and manual pages in the document store.
How many of those pages are already text rather than print.
research_questions: What share of the magazines and manuals is already a text file she can mark?

already_counted.description: She still attends the show, reads the pages and chooses the preference.

incremental.description: No second catalogue. Marked pages stay inside the review she already does.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: In a season of print-only magazines the quote note does not run, so the saving is none. In a season where the manuals are already text in the document store, most of the copying returns, and the show and the choice do not.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Buy clothing and accessories to complete a design

steps.what: Read items needed to complete the designs
Judge clothing and accessory pieces on the rail
Purchase the chosen clothing or accessory in person
Post the purchased item fields into the inventory

tasks.design: She still judges the piece on the rail and pays the seller in person. Supplier, item, price, currency and design id, written on the receipt, post into {PROCUREMENT} so she does not retype them into the tracker. A blank field or a later edit stops the post.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right piece is a judgement of hand, colour and price in the shop. Used items have no stable code a catalogue can match.
tasks.enabler_now: Four fields she already writes at the till can fill the inventory row without a second typing.
tasks.still_hard: Whether that piece completes the design, and whether a used find is worth the price.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the piece and pays the seller.
tasks.altitude: She still shops and pays. The inventory post does not choose the item and does not place the order.

reach.task: Specify a bought part on a product
reach.learn: Name the item so someone else can see which piece completes the design.

evidence.claim: Copying supplier, item, price and currency from a receipt note into a second list is a retype. A configured post can do that copy only when those fields are already written. It cannot judge a used piece on a rail.

assumptions: This task is a buy she makes to complete a design. A standing supplier contract and a purchase order above her card limit are other tasks.
The payment is the in-person act. It is not a document sent to the seller, so it is not a separate gated release.
Receipt fields are supplier_name, item_name, price, currency and design_id. She writes them at s3. If one is blank, the post does not run and she types the row herself.
Today she retypes that row into the tracker. The machine is only the future of that retype. She remains the person who buys.
A change to price or item after s3 voids the post until she writes the fields again.
No mapping list is kept beyond those fields, so ongoing upkeep beyond the steps is zero.
unknowns: Whether a buyer, not the designer, already types the receipt into purchasing.
The card limit above which this buy is no longer hers.
research_questions: After she pays, does she retype the receipt into a second list, and is that list hers?

already_counted.description: She still reads the gap, judges the piece and pays the seller.

incremental.description: No extra item catalogue. The receipt fields are part of the purchase she already writes.

approvals.approved_version: Receipt fields supplier_name, item_name, price, currency and design_id as written at the purchase

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When she does not keep a second list, the post does not run. When she retypes receipts today, most of that retype returns. The shop and the payment do not.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit textile showrooms for the latest fabrics

steps.what: Visit textile showrooms and handle the latest fabrics
Write the fabric note after the showroom visit

tasks.design: She still visits the showroom and handles the cloth. The fabric note is a record she writes after the visit. Nothing in the visit is handed to a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hand, weight and colour are judged on the cloth. A mill page cannot stand in for that, and the visit is only a few times a year.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the visit. A page of mill claims would still need her hand on the cloth.
tasks.still_hard: Which cloth is worth a later sample, and which mill is worth the trip.
tasks.human_edge: She handles the cloth and decides what is worth noting.
tasks.altitude: The visit stays in her year. She gains no decision right, and no list is kept for her by a machine.

reach.learn: Write hand, weight and colour so someone who was not in the showroom can compare two cloths.

evidence.claim: A showroom visit is in person. Hand and colour of cloth are not something a page or a feed can settle, so this task keeps its time.

assumptions: This task is the visit and the note. Ordering cloth and paying a mill are other tasks.
There is no structured feed. No field is captured for a machine, and no machine step is named.
The fabric note is the task itself. It is not a second catalogue, so ongoing upkeep beyond the steps is zero.
The visit is a few times a year. No weekly admin is added.
unknowns: Whether some mills she visits already send cloth pages she reads before she goes.
Who else, if anyone, uses the fabric note after she writes it.
research_questions: Is any part of this visit already skipped because a mill appointment replaced it?

already_counted.description: She still visits, handles the cloth and writes the note.

incremental.description: No swatch catalogue beyond the note she writes in the visit.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The visit and the cloth judgement do not shorten. No second list is kept, and no machine step is added, in a light season or a busy one.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Adapt another designer's idea for the mass market

steps.what: Read other designers' ideas she may adapt
Set the mass market price and construction
Draft one flat that states her construction choices

loop.input: Her target_price, construction, piece_count and the reference note from s1
loop.output: One flat image that states those choices
loop.check: The flat states her construction and target price, and it does not add a logo or a print her note did not name. Otherwise it is unmarked and dropped.
loop.stop: One draft, or stop when the check fails. She redraws without it.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed outline cannot tell a copied print from a construction change.

steps.what: Redraw the adaptation she will keep
Show the redrawn adaptation to the product manager

tasks.design: She sets the price and the construction, then a marked draft in {DOCS} proposes one flat that states those choices. She redraws the adaptation and shows that redraw to the product manager. The draft is not sent outside and is not the version the line keeps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adapting a look for a price was a drawing she made. A generated image can copy a print, and it may not be artwork the company owns.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can state her price and construction, carry a mark that names the model, and stop when it adds a print she did not name.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the simpler construction still reads as the idea, and whether she may use the reference at all.
tasks.human_edge: She redraws what the line keeps and what the product manager is shown.
tasks.altitude: She still sets the price band and redraws the flat. The draft does not approve an adaptation and does not leave the team.

reach.task: Simplify a design for a price band
reach.learn: Which construction changes keep the idea once the price is a mass-market price.

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images and can attach content credentials that name the model and the time.
Text-to-image adopters produced more work at first and their average novelty fell, so the mass-market edit stays her redraw rather than the draft.
The Munich Local Court denied copyright protection to three AI-generated logos despite a long prompt, so the draft is not treated as owned artwork.
A European Parliament study finds fully AI outputs unprotected, so the company should not treat the draft as the owned adaptation.
From 2 August 2026, providers must mark generated images so a machine can read the mark. The draft carries that mark and is not the version shown outside.

assumptions: This task ends at an internal review with the product manager. A factory send, a buyer send and a public release are other tasks, so there is no gated external release here.

Fields are target_price, construction and piece_count, plus a reference_note. She writes them in s2 and s1. If construction or target_price is empty, or the reference is look-only, the draft does not run.
The draft is ungated and is not checked by a later gate on itself. She redraws in s4. The product manager sees the redraw, not the draft.
Today she draws the first flat. The machine is only the future of that first drawing. She remains the person who adapts.
The draft is marked and is not treated as artwork the company owns. No template library is kept as extra work, so ongoing upkeep beyond the steps is zero.
The design does not score her output or log her pace.
unknowns: Which references the company has a right to study, and which are look-only.
Whether the product manager expects a physical sample at the same review.
research_questions: Which references may be passed into a draft, and which must stay as images she only looks at?

already_counted.description: She still reads the reference, sets price and construction, redraws, and shows the product manager.

incremental.description: No template library. Price and construction stay in the choice she already writes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the reference is protected artwork she will not pass across, the draft does not run. When the reference is her own earlier flat, the draft can state her construction, and the redraw and the review stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still attends shows, buys the piece, handles cloth and redraws the adaptation. A quote note and an inventory post do not choose the line.
skills_to_grow: Quote the magazine page in the trend note instead of a paraphrase that could be an advertisement.
Write supplier, item, price and currency once at the purchase so the inventory post has fields.
State price and construction before a sketch draft, and keep the redraw as the version the line uses.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent attends a show, pays a seller, or releases an adaptation. A later costing or pattern task is not claimed here.
